title: Project 1: Job Tracker Application
description: Built a Job Tracker web application using the MERN stack to help users manage job applications efficiently. Implemented features like application status tracking, profile management, and job search with filters for a seamless user experience. Designed a responsive and interactive UI with real-time updates to enhance productivity and simplify job-hunting workflow.

title: Project 2: Movie Search App
description: Engineered a responsive movie search application using JavaScript and React, integrating the OMDB API for real-time data retrieval.

title: Project 3: Taskify App
description: Engineered a feature-rich task scheduling app, Taskify, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, incorporating a sleek UI and interactive components to improve task organization and productivity.

title: Project 4: E-Commerce Website ShopperStore
description: Developed a full-stack e-commerce website using the MERN (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) stack, featuring user authentication, product management, cart functionality, and a seamless shopping experience.

title: Project 5: Meme Generator App
description: Designed and developed a dynamic Meme Generator App using React, leveraging state management to facilitate real-time text customization and meme rendering.
